name: Laden Dew Gland
summary: A Laden Dew Gland holds water gathered by a dew collector in Tanaris. Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan wants one to ease his thirst.

sections.title: Water for Marin
sections.body: Southwest of Gadgetzan, Thistleshrub Valley is home to dew collectors that store water in special glands. Marin Noggenfogger asks you to bring him a Laden Dew Gland, hoping it will quench his terrible thirst.

faq.q: What is a Laden Dew Gland?
faq.answer: A Laden Dew Gland is a water-filled organ carried by dew collectors in Thistleshrub Valley.
Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan wants a Laden Dew Gland to try to quench his thirst.

faq.q: Where do I find a Laden Dew Gland?
faq.answer: Thistleshrub Dew Collectors in Thistleshrub Valley, southwest of Gadgetzan, carry Laden Dew Glands.
Marin hopes the water stored in the gland will make a drink that quenches his terrible thirst.
